{"consolidated_memory":"SILENT DROP ISSUES IN notifications/push/dispatch.py (3 separate incidents)

All three incidents share the same general symptom (silent drop in dispatcher—send reports success with no delivery) but triggered under different conditions and had distinct root causes, each fixed separately.

**INCIDENT 1 [2026-03-24] — N+1 Query Behind Lazy Relation**
- Component: notifications/push/dispatch.py
- Trigger condition: input list came in empty; reproduced via dispatch to rotated device token
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Signal: send reports success with no delivery
- Impact/Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 63 days running
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #1223, branch fix/silent-drop-1
- Context: same corner of notifications/push/dispatch.py as earlier silent drop work

**INCIDENT 2 [2026-07-03] — Naive vs Aware Datetime Comparison**
- Component: notifications/push/dispatch.py
- Trigger condition: clients still pinned to v1 SDK; reproduced via dispatch to rotated device token
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
- Signal: send reports success with no delivery
- Impact/Result: 98 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #6382, branch fix/silent-drop-2
- Context: same corner of notifications/push/dispatch.py as earlier silent drop work

**INCIDENT 3 [2026-07-27] — Floating Point Rounding in Money Path**
- Component: notifications/push/dispatch.py
- Trigger condition: staging read replica only; reproduced via dispatch to rotated device token
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Signal: send reports success with no delivery
- Impact/Result: flaky test went from 44 failures per 100 runs to zero
- Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #8815, branch fix/silent-drop-3
- Context: same corner of notifications/push/dispatch.py as earlier silent drop work"}
